description: Delete one repeating wake-up rule for good, with its runs and history. Waiting runs never fire and it cannot be restored. It frees a rule slot and works after the plan ended too. Returns deleted: true; an unknown or already deleted schedule_id answers schedule_not_found. To pause or change it and keep its history, use schedule_update. wakeup_cancel is for one-shot calls only.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

schedule_id.description: schedule id (wsc_...) from schedule_create or schedule_list.

name: schedule_delete
title: Delete a repeating wake-up
